name: RIXO
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $285 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Printed and embroidered midi dresses, skirts, knitwear and jackets, mostly $300–$600, plus bridal, sold mainly through its own London and New York stores and its site.
origin: Founded in London, United Kingdom in 2015 by Henrietta Rix; Orlagh McCloskey.

quote.q: We make clothes we hope will inspire you to be a little more creative, a little more you, in how you dress.

opview: “We make clothes we hope will inspire you to be a little more creative, a little more you, in how you dress.” — RIXO (house), World of RIXO (About), rixolondon.com
